selfReview.type: AI own-locale direct Japanese semantic and continuous Khmer prose self-review
selfReview.method: Read all Japanese paragraphs, lesson metadata and question sets; translated full connected Khmer and reviewed source meaning and continuous target prose. Checked medical actors/recipients, sudden-change response versus long-term management, observation versus diagnosis, individual instructions/training and negation/uncertainty. Reviewed7stems/28options/28individualrationales, all lesson metadata and matching case contexts. Final source-binding and prior-preservation verification after editorial refinements.
semanticChecks: Cerebral infarction obstruction/lack of blood versus hemorrhage from broken vessel, site/extent of injury and individual abilities retained. Angina temporary reduced myocardial flow versus infarction obstruction/injury/necrosis fully explained, pain intensity not diagnostic. Hypertension/diabetes/coronary changes and actual diagnosis/treatment checked explicitly with medical professionals. Heart failure output insufficiency and breathlessness/palpitations/fatigue/edema/weight/urine changes are clues, not one-symptom diagnosis.

Headache/dizziness/nausea/vomiting/consciousness/sensation/breathing changes not exclusive to cerebrovascular disease. Sudden paralysis/speech abnormality/breathlessness/severe chest pain require prompt emergency help/notification without waiting to confirm cause. Forward-lean sitting is example not forced universal posture; person distress and tolerable posture follow medical instructions/individual plan, adjusted posture not proof of recovery. Salt/fluid/activity depend on evaluated plan; disease name cannot authorize restriction/continued exercise. Urgent initial response distinct from long-term management. Actual time/words/baseline difference/actions explicitly reported to medical professionals.

Pneumonia inflammatory disease with bacterial/viral factors, fever/fatigue/appetiteloss/cough/sputum and incomplete obvious symptom constellation in older adults retained. Swallowing-process disorder distinct from aspiration into airway; saliva with bacteria as well as food/drink can lead to aspiration pneumonia. No observed choking/cough cannot guarantee no aspiration. Oral cleanliness/posture/foodform reduce risk without complete prevention; nurse and speech/language/hearing professional assessment retained. Postmeal positioning individualized. Abnormal breathing/choking/voice/expression means stop assistance and seek help/report by facility methods, not keep feeding as a test or independently change fluid/posture/foodform. No self-directed diagnostic swallowing tests/drugs/emergency techniques.

Persistent hyperglycemia, insulin and cellular glucose use, primarily immune-mediated pancreatic insulin-cell damage in type1, any-age onset despite younger prevalence retained. Type2 reduced insulin effectiveness plus insufficient secretion and multiple factors retained without blame. Thirst/drinking/urination/fatigue/unexplained weightloss and few-symptom possibility preserved. Confirmed medical diagnosis, measured glucose/treatment within plan/assignedscope; careworker not independently setting food/activity/drugtype/dose.

Diabetic retina/kidney/peripheralnerve complications distinct. Reduced sensation can conceal pain despite wound and sustained hyperglycemia impair healing. Person saying no pain important but not proof of no wound/safety/normal nerve function. Wound/redness/erosion site/appearance/personsensation/noticedtime reported by facility plan; no omitted record or concealed course through independent medication. Food/activity/drugs combined in treatment plan with person satisfaction/wishes, no additional restrictions/dose changes without consultation; observation/coordination not wound diagnosis/procedure.

Congenital/disease/accident/aging vision causes, acuity versus field, no vision/light detection/narrow range individual variation retained. Central scotoma may spare periphery, fieldconstriction limitedrange, enlarging letters not fieldrestoration. Unilateral spatial neglect brainattention impairment differs from unilateral fieldloss; coexistence and separate evaluation preserved. Missing one tray side not cause/support diagnosis. Ask person perception; position/light/text/explanation match evaluation/wishes, no unauthorized rearrangement removing personal cues. Black diagram area not actual person field, no staff diagnosis of lesion/site.

Pacemaker protects verified implantedsite instructions without blanket activity ban/settingschange. Hemodialysis blood out to external device, some waste/excessfluid removed, blood returned; vascularaccess protected. Armload/bathingday/method/salt/fluid checked with treating team individual instructions, no universal dayban/amount; abnormal bleeding/swelling promptly reported. Portable oxygen cylinder/concentrator distinct from ventilation-support respirator. Oxygen supports combustion and fire/burnrisk; prescribedflow/settings untouched. Fireavoidance/infection/powerfailure/supply interruption and device-specificbackup reviewed with facility/homeplan. Fecal/urinary abdominalstoma positions/mechanisms differ; not all bladderdisability has stoma. Appliance/excreta handling requires plan/training; redness/erosion/leak/change report, inexperiencedstaff no improvised adjustments. Text alone not authorization to operate/procedure.

Intellectualdevelopment/adaptation difficulty distinct from mentalillness; individual understanding/lifeproblems and adult dignity maintained, slower comprehension not infantilization. History/current lifestage/wishes/choice and capabilities retained. Different psychiatric diseases including schizophrenia/mooddisorders, episodic decision/behavior difficulties not universal incapacity/danger. Depressed mood/interestloss versus manic elevation/activity, single quiet/talkative encounter not diagnosis. Hallucination without corresponding external stimulus, delusion strong belief despite reality discrepancy, auditory hallucination subtype, specialist assessment preserved. Accepting fear/distress distinct from endorsing content as fact; calm listening without argument/dismissal, link help and facility emergency response for threatened safety. No diagnostic/medication guide.

All7question sets retain28options and28full specific rationales with fixed correctIndex. Seven explicit-empty readingJa fields map to seven reading:"" fields,0absent/full. All7contexts exactly reuse own matching case paragraphs. Seven artcaptions retain contextual and non-diagnostic/nonprocedural limits; no figureCaptions invented.
